title: Improve duplicate-name retrieval context for primary DM lookup
description:
Finding source:
- Codex Low finding: duplicate names are expected but name-only retrieval is unsafe.
- 88 normalized duplicate-name groups include Spellcasting, Ability Score Improvement, Druid, Acolyte, Hide, Shield, and Potion of Healing.
- Records generally have unique keys and context, but primary DM model discoverability depends on retrieval/display using that context.

Acceptance criteria:
- Retrieval/display cards expose key, kind, parent class/subclass/background/item context, source locator, and disambiguating category.
- Deterministic tools use keys/refs, not names.
- Add fixtures/tests for ambiguous cases: Hide action vs hiding rule, Shield spell vs shield equipment, Potion of Healing item variants, repeated Spellcasting features.
notes: PR #388 opened: adds buildRulesRecordCard() card summary to lookup_rules success results and structured candidateKeys on ambiguous errors. Awaiting review/merge.
close_reason: Merged PR #388 on main (b110b2f): buildRulesRecordCard() adds key/kind/name/source-locator/grantor-ref card to lookup_rules success results; ambiguous errors carry structured candidateKeys. Tests cover Spellcasting/ASI same-kind ambiguity and Hide/Shield/Potion of Healing cross-kind duplicates.
